title: 2009 Prairie's tall chimney moves to the wall its photograph shows
items: In 1904, the tall chimney of 2009 Prairie Avenue now rises astride the north wall, where the old photograph puts it, instead of standing inside the roof; its head is laid in courses that step out under a stone cap, as the photograph draws it, and the chimney farther back gets the same head.
The gable's south foot is still to come.
